author: Xeise
body:
I haven't ban evaded anything. Me and Vice already conversed about the hours I've played. I've played 2 days in total on my account I believe. The banned account was something my friend gave me when he bought diamond because I wanted to play it. He set himself on a VPN i believe while all his infractions were to me. That's why i was banned. All the infractions that he was given were transfered to my IP, which ended up in me getting banned.
-Ask Vicey
-So yeah I have more than enough hours played and I should be unbanned
